scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter "./cloudflare" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.prepare: git config --get core.hooksPath >/dev/null 2>&1 || git config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || true
